# Cypher Digital

> Digital marketing agency in Sri Lanka helping SMEs grow with social media, paid ads, SEO, video, and design. WhatsApp-first: +94 70 177 2626.

Cypher Digital (cypherdigital.lk) is a Colombo-based digital marketing agency serving Sri Lankan small and medium businesses across hospitality, retail, real estate, education, healthcare, beauty, automotive, and e-commerce. We focus strictly on digital channels — no TV, billboard, or display ad production for our own clients (we publish educational guides on traditional channels for comparison only).

## Core Services

- [Social Media Management Sri Lanka](/social-media-management-sri-lanka): Monthly content, community management, and growth for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn.
- [Facebook Ads Sri Lanka](/facebook-ads-sri-lanka): Meta ad campaigns for lead generation, sales, and brand awareness.
- [Google Ads Sri Lanka](/google-ads-sri-lanka): Search, display, YouTube, and Performance Max campaigns managed for ROI.
- [SEO Services Sri Lanka](/seo-services-sri-lanka): Technical SEO, on-page optimization, content, and local search ranking.
- [Video Production Sri Lanka](/video-production-sri-lanka): Corporate, ad, and social video shoots and editing.
- [Graphic Design Sri Lanka](/graphic-design-sri-lanka): Logos, brand identity, social creatives, print, packaging, and UI design.
- [TikTok Marketing Sri Lanka](/tiktok-marketing-sri-lanka): Organic content and TikTok ad management.
- [Instagram Marketing Sri Lanka](/instagram-marketing-sri-lanka): Reels, content, and Instagram ad campaigns.
- [LinkedIn Marketing Sri Lanka](/linkedin-marketing-sri-lanka): B2B lead generation and thought leadership.
- [Influencer Marketing Sri Lanka](/influencer-marketing-sri-lanka): Creator partnerships and campaign management.
- [Media Buying Agencies Sri Lanka](/media-buying-agencies-sri-lanka): Cross-channel paid media planning and buying.
- [Event Management Sri Lanka](/event-management-sri-lanka): Corporate events, product launches, weddings, and event marketing.
